finalize_ordering.consequence: the four passes delete members without reordering surviving informationList entries

front_sync_rule.ordinary_connection: the later activated front calls NoteBase.SetupSyncLine with the preceding eligible front as sync target
front_sync_rule.multiple_directional_exclusion: adjacent FrontNoteType MultipleDirectionalFlick members with the same GameNoteType use the dedicated back-line route
front_sync_rule.direction_group_exclusion: Long and Slide additional directional members use IsSameDirectionGroup and tail reconnection instead of the ordinary front chain
front_sync_rule.integrated_scope: all projected front roots retain source activation order; ordinary fronts chain, while arriving Long or Slide After candidates take priority at the same absolute position

after_sync_rule.candidate_lifetime: a Long or Slide root contributes its future terminal After endpoint; candidates older than the current batch position expire
after_sync_rule.front_priority: setupSyncLineForFrontAndLongNoteEnd scans candidate order and connects the first same-position After that is not a same-group multiple-direction support relation
after_sync_rule.remaining_pairing: setupSyncLineForLongNoteEnd connects the first two remaining same-position After endpoints; ordinary endpoints are then removed
after_sync_rule.multiple_retention: AfterNoteType 4, 5, 11 and 12 remain eligible for the subsequent multiple-direction reconnect pass

far_endpoint_rule.tuple_order: getFarNote returns the instantiated note group's far-left and far-right endpoints through virtual methods
far_endpoint_rule.reconnect: syncLineReconnectAfterMultiNotes compares endpoint X and replaces each side with the outward far endpoint
far_endpoint_rule.adapter_projection: SyncEndpointSpec records front/end and left/right endpoint identity; Slide endpoints additionally preserve the selected side-node id

inference: filtered additional support records are represented by the owning NoteSpec far endpoint rather than independent playable NoteSpec objects
